content:
## Severity and version
High; SDK 1.101.0; pal_found_cli_skills candidate based on HEAD b40d0be, 2026-10-09.

## Reproduction
Source-blind J12 reader .ept/tmp/feature015-j12-reader/reader-results.md scored 4/6 in .ept/tmp/feature015_rest_semantic_review/j12_independent_score.md. It followed local Transaction.md lines 91-99 and 125-160, File.md upload section, and Build.md lines 59-90. The composed code omits staged File.get/content before commit and postcommit branch/file verification; it exits on any terminal Build state without marking FAILED/CANCELED unsuccessful. Six individual SDK fake-transport examples pass, but no composed sequence runs.

## Expected behavior
Offline guidance and a runnable root-client fixture verify transaction-view file state before commit, committed branch/file state afterward, and RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELED/poll-exhaustion separately. Upload or commit timeout is reconciled before replay.

## Acceptance criteria
- Coordinate dataset-view portion with DEV-STORY-074; keep integrated Build journey under DEV-STORY-075.
- Add composed SDK1.101.0 fake-transport example and regression for all listed states and checks.
- Fresh source-blind reader passes all six J12 dimensions using only standalone skill/prepared runtime.
- Preserve failed artifact and distinguish fixture from tenant operation.

## Test reference
TESTEXEC-064 comment 20261009-092807-qa-engineer. Related to DEV-STORY-074; Blocks TESTEXEC-064. No FileImport or unrelated namespace scope.

﻿type: bug_subtask
id_prefix: BUG-SUB
description: >-
  Bug sub-task: defect investigation and fix activity nested under a DEV-STORY, created when defects are found during QA testing.
required_fields: [id, type, title, status, parent, created, updated]
optional_fields: [priority, resolution, assignee, reporter, component, labels,
                  estimated_hours, time_spent_hours, due_date]
initial_status: New
terminal_statuses: [Closed, Canceled, Rejected, Duplicated]
statuses:
  New:
    description: Created; triage and prerequisites validation.
    stage_goal: Triage the sub-task, validate readiness, and move to Open.
    responsible_roles:
      - Creator (Assignee)

    description: Prerequisites validated; ready to start work.
    stage_goal: Prepare for work once prerequisites are met.
    responsible_roles:

    stage_goal: Investigate root cause and implement fix.
    responsible_roles:
      - Developer

    stage_goal: Verify blocking condition remains, maintain blocker links and priorities, and return to prior status when unblocked.
    responsible_roles:
      - Current assignee

    description: Fix implemented; ready for verification.
    stage_goal: Manage blockers and prepare for closure.
    responsible_roles:
      - Developer
  Closed:
    description: Verified and archived.
    stage_goal: Archive the completed sub-task.
    responsible_roles:
      - Assignee
  Canceled:
    description: Sub-task canceled before completion.
    stage_goal: Record cancellation rationale and archive.
    responsible_roles:
      - Assignee
      - Reporter
  Rejected:
    description: Sub-task rejected as invalid or out of scope.
    stage_goal: Record rejection reason and archive.
    responsible_roles:
      - Assignee

  Resolved:    [Closed, Canceled, Rejected, Duplicated, Blocked, In Progress]
  Closed:      [Resolved]
  Canceled:    []
  Rejected:    []
  Duplicated:  []

          - Assignee set to creator
          - Parent Story context reviewed
          - Blockers identified and recorded (links or question)
          - Required fields validated (status, assignee, priority, dates)

      - IF test evidence exists THEN link as a comment on this ticket.
    transition_dods:

          - Studied related documentation from the `.ept/docs/document_index.md`
          - Critical thinking applied
          - All required questions asked using the Question sub-tasks and all these sub-tasks are in terminal status (Closed, Done, Canceled, Rejected, Duplicated)
          - Specific unsatisfied requirement identified OR detailed error message provided
          - Steps to reproduce documented
          - Expected vs actual behavior described
          - Environment details captured
          - Application logs attached
          - Fix plan created as a comment on this ticket

  In Progress:
    instructions:
      - Apply critical thinking and ask questions.
      - IF you need to clarify any question with other team members listed in the `.ept/docs/resources/available_resources.md` THEN create a QUESTION sub-task addressed to the appropriate role, add a Blocks link and a Question link from it to this ticket, set status to Blocked until resolved, and record blocker ID and prior status as a comment on this ticket.
      - IF blocked by dependency THEN add a blocking link, set status to Blocked until resolved, and record blocker ID and prior status as a comment on this ticket.
      - IF lower-priority blocker blocks higher-priority Bug THEN raise blocker priority.
      - ELSE investigate root cause and document as a comment on this ticket.
      - Apply fix and document implementation.
    transition_dods:
      - target_statuses: [Resolved]
        dod_criteria:
          - Studied related documentation from the `.ept/docs/document_index.md`
          - Critical thinking applied
          - All required questions asked using the Question sub-tasks and all these sub-tasks are in terminal status (Closed, Done, Canceled, Rejected, Duplicated)
          - Fix implemented and tested
          - Root cause documented
          - Regression test performed
          - Time reported in subtask frontmatter
          - All links registered

  Resolved:
    instructions:
      - QA verifies fix and records evidence.
      - IF this ticket blocks any other tickets with the source_role=Blocks link(s) THEN remove these links.
      - IF not blocked THEN ready to move to Closed.
    transition_dods:
      - target_statuses: [Closed]
        dod_criteria:
          - Fix verified by QA
          - Ticket not blocked (no active `blocks` links)

  Closed:
    instructions:
      - Terminal status. Archive only; no edits.
    transition_dods: []

  Blocked:
    instructions:
      - Confirm blocker and prior status are documented as a comment on this ticket (include blocker ID and prior status).
      - Verify blocking link exists on this ticket.
      - Do not create new blocker links in this status; they must be created when the block is identified.
      - IF blocking link missing THEN create QUESTION ticket addressed_to appropriate role, add a Blocks link and a Question link from it to this ticket, and remain Blocked.
      - |
        Query blocking links on this ticket. For each blocker found, check its status:
          - IF blocker status IN `Closed`, `Done`, `Canceled`, `Rejected`, `Duplicated` THEN remove the blocking link and return to prior status
          - IF blocker still active AND blocker priority lower than this ticket priority THEN raise blocker priority to match.
      - IF all blocking links removed THEN return this ticket to prior status.
    transition_dods: []

args: Independent J12 six-dimension QA verified against committed immutable evidence

## Independent verification
Separate reader /root/j12_reader_recover_20261028 and grader /root/j12_independent_grade_20261028 passed all six approved J12 dimensions. The fresh reader composes SDK1.101 root-client transaction/file/branch calls plus Build.create; independent byte-identical reproduction matched all 12 synthetic outcomes. Staged metadata/content precede commit; COMMITTED transaction, branch pointer and visible file metadata/content follow it. SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELED and bounded pending are distinct. Lost upload/applied-commit replies do not duplicate mutations; safe no-effect commit retry requires transaction/branch/content reconciliation, and pending journal resume does not resubmit a build.

## Committed evidence
Evidence is committed in skills revision e44b97ed51f438ea495096287565cd064c77b150. QA independently checked all 90 archived artifacts against that Git commit, acceptance SHA256 6acb2c856d19e3478879cb984b9ac62f2352b5b9ddd33f0044f58fa2ac54cae9, archive-context SHA256 5fc3edf93369f1ab06466fe00e4ef44073da7dd77b4f03f8f3cfaaaabe781828, and separate grade SHA256 0b81f4c254d2f21cf19217e4eb9c158a2430d2d4a5809718d96e899b0a0f582c. All 23 consulted skill sources still match their reviewed hashes. Reader answer SHA256 65cc2f91075a54a5902e948801d706c87a119ec404f6044bcb04bee559015fe8; 32 original artifact hashes and the 4437-file snapshot remain bound by retained manifests. Original 4/6 failure artifacts are preserved in the archive. The current b260986e composed example regression also has seven passing synthetic outcomes, recorded separately from the fresh reader.

## Closure scope
Current Resolved DoD is satisfied: fix independently verified; no linked Question or incoming blocker exists. Remove only its outgoing Blocks LINK-01894 and preserve RelatesTo LINK-01893 before Closed/Done. Developer root-cause, fix, regression and time reporting were checked; unmeasured contributor hours remain untracked. This closes BUG-SUB-025 only. Full TESTEXEC-064, REST075 formal acceptance, FEATURE-015 and release publication remain separate. Mock SDK/HTTP and per-process network denial do not establish live tenant effects, permissions, OS-wide isolation or concurrency safety.
